title: Rules 20: no Closing Day or jam maker; one perk each in the Daily market and the League
problem: The owner, 2026-11-16: "remove closing day completely from the game, there's no jam maker". REP-122 C-01: in the Daily market and the League a person can be dealt a rival's perk, and two Nest Eggs leave one doing nothing (owner chose: deal only perks no rival holds).
scope: The last day is an ordinary day: customers pay no extra $1, and fruit left at the end is worth nothing

The jam maker, Closing Day and "Last Call" leave the engine, the computer players, the screens, How to play, the tips, RULES.md and the guidebook; the Market Days switch no longer brings a Closing Day
The trophy "Nothing for the jam maker" is renamed "Sold out" (same condition: sell 20 or more pieces and end with no ripe fruit), and stamps already earned are kept
C-01: the Daily market and the League deal only perks no rival holds
RULES_VERSION 19 to 20 (a game saved mid-way on 1.24.0 cannot be continued, as with every rules change; the Daily leaderboard starts a new board)
S1 (the last day's places leave out the jam money) goes away with the jam maker
Balance: npm run balance before and after; any shopkeeper moving more than 3 points is reported to the owner before publishing
exclusions: Any other rule or price change

acceptance.evidence: npm run verify on the merge 0ff8d2c (with PLAN-107): records, palette, lint, types, 972 tests passed (1 skipped, as before), build. New tests/last-day.test.ts and tests/rules20.test.ts: last-day prices equal an ordinary day's, nothing paid for leftovers, takings equal the results over 10 games at 2 to 6 stalls (S1), the trophy, the perk deal over 120 Daily dates, every League stage x 150 seeds and 600 random set-ups, and a rules-19 save refused with its notice.

Helper run on its branch: E2E OK, 0 leaks (speed test passed on its own retry). On the merge 0ff8d2c every part passed (solo game, online match with a leaver: 0 leaks in 32 pricing frames, no page errors; quick match; four players; reconnect 5 cycles) but the speed test failed twice (239 and 207 ms over the 200 ms limit) while two helpers were installing; run alone on the quiet machine it passed (162 ms). CI runs the whole set again before 1.25.0.

acceptance.text: The changed screens seen at 390x844 and 360x640
acceptance.evidence: Two whole games to the results at 390x844 (4 stalls) and 360x640 (3 stalls): the last morning ("Last day: anything unsold tonight is worth $0.", "Unsold = $0"), stocking, takings ("MARKET CLOSED", the list equal to the results: $98/$63/$56/$51 and $122/$89/$34), results; the Daily perk choice (only perks no rival holds), the trophy card, How to play. Guidebook pages 2, 5, 6, 7, 11, the change sheet and the player aid seen. Pictures in the session scratchpad p108/.

acceptance.text: The owner has checked the result on the preview
Balance report before and after recorded in RULES.md
acceptance.evidence: RULES.md "Rules version 20": shopkeeper win shares and average cash before and after at 2, 3, 4 and 6 Normal stalls and 3 and 4 Hard stalls (rules 18 scripts, 2,000 to 4,000 games a side). Ah Chen at 3 Hard stalls moved -3.1 points; a second batch of 7,200 games on new seeds gave +0.4, and over both (9,600 a side) no shopkeeper moved more than 0.7 points. Average cash about $4 lower at every table. npm run balance and npm run simulate agree.

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-16: "okay approve" (to REP-123). The trophy name "Sold out" and two releases (1.24.1 with PLAN-107, then 1.25.0) were the recommendations in REP-123, approved with the plan; each release still needs his word to publish.
